notes:
v4.6.97 — IBKR bots no longer hang on a slow gateway (cleanup / first-stock stall fixed)

🩺 THE HANG
• On the first cycle an IBKR bot qualifies its whole universe against the gateway (up to 6 exchanges × ~37 symbols). qualifyContracts/reqTickers had NO timeout, so when the shared gateway was slow the bot froze right after the startup cleanup, or couldn’t get past the first stock.
• Now every gateway request (contract qualify + market-data) has a hard timeout. The moment the gateway is slow, the bot STOPS hammering it, skips the universe filter for that cycle and trades by name (pricing falls back to a fast source). No more multi-minute freezes.

This is primarily a cloud/server fix (where your IBKR bots run); the desktop carries the same code for local IBKR.

Update via the in-app banner.
